headline: Property slump weighs on rebar demand; Feng Hsing: prices bottoming out, watching September peak season | Industry
summary: Feng Hsing said domestic rebar consumption fell 14.2% year on year in the first half. Prices are near their lows, though international raw material prices have recently rebounded.
why: Rebar is a steel product used mainly in construction, so weak property demand directly affects steel producers and their pricing.
